videoDetails.title: Your effort level is STILL TOO HIGH
videoDetails.shortDescription:
Learn why setting your AI agent's effort level too high is sabotaging your coding tasks. In this video, Matt explains the crucial difference between effort levels and why lower settings often produce better results for code exploration and simple changes.
